column1: # TrueMed ESP32 partition table (4 MB flash)
# Why a custom table instead of the default: the stock "default.csv" gives the
# filesystem about 1.5 MB but only ~1.2 MB per OTA slot
# slots. This firmware has no OTA path (the device lives in a sealed cold box and
# is reflashed over USB during servicing)
column2: so the second app slot is dead weight.

column1: # Trading it for filesystem space directly buys offline endurance: every extra
# 100 KB of LittleFS is roughly another 800 buffered readings
# 2.8 days of outage survived at one reading per 5 minutes.
# One app slot of 1.9 MB is ample - the build lands near 900 KB with WiFi and
# mbedTLS linked in - and leaves ~1.9 MB of filesystem.
